text:
ash: Hey team, trial user reported a confusing error while following the Docker quickstart. Their container logs show a 402 and the console button says 'Set payment method' with no extra context. They expected the one-time demo call to work.

miri: Can you paste the exact docker-compose snippet or the env vars used?

ash: They used the starter compose from docs with REDWOOD_API_KEY set and workspace rdw-demo-314. Logs: {"error":{"code":402,"message":"Workspace payment method required: rdw-demo-314"}}

sam: This is from the policy change: production models require a payment method. We didn't update the quickstart text to explain the preview model fallback.

ash: So there isn't any free one-shot anymore? The console copy led them to believe they'd get a sample response.

sam: Correct — removed grace due to abuse. Short-term fix: recommend the dev-preview model in quickstarts (redwood-mini-preview) for demos. Long-term: product should clarify console copy and maybe offer a verified-email sample allowance.

jess: Filing UX ticket to change the button tooltip to "Production models require a payment method; use the preview model for trial calls." Also adding an FAQ entry for CS repro steps.

miri: Devex action: add a small troubleshooting note in the Docker quickstart and an explicit example overriding the model to redwood-mini-preview.

ash: Pushed a tiny docs change and the customer validated that switching to redwood-mini-preview returned 200 with expected output.

devex-bot: Runbook link posted -> https://go/runbooks/onboarding-billing-blocks

ash: Closing thread — leaving PR link in comments.
